KYM_SPOOKY_SCARY_SKELETONS_NARROW_GALLER.reason: Public image gallery exposes 9 images, below preregistered minimum N=15.

TENOR_GIPHY_SEARCH.reason: Default search endpoints are relevance/ranking based; this violates the non-ranked prevalence-frame requirement.

WAYBACK_IMGFILP_TEMPLATE_SNAPSHOT.reason: Direct CDX check for the exact Imgflip template URL returned no usable captures; cannot enumerate a frozen N>=15 frame.

KYM_SKELETONS_MASTER_GALLERY.reason: Parent Skeletons gallery exposes 832 items with stable photo IDs; all 832 were enumerated and frozen before context coding.

estimand.primary: Distribution of context classes among direct or near-direct The Skeleton Dance (1929) visual reencodings represented inside the frozen KYM Skeletons master-gallery frame.
estimand.scope_boundary: This is conditionally unbiased within the frozen KYM frame. It is NOT an estimator of all internet uses of The Skeleton Dance.

frame_construction.source: Know Your Meme / Skeletons image gallery
frame_construction.enumeration_method: Fetch all 52 pages at sort=newest, 16 gallery items per page, record stable KYM photo IDs, verify 832 total and 832 unique, freeze ordered-ID payload and SHA-256 before eligibility or context coding.

deterministic_randomization.purpose: Avoid chronological start-point bias while preserving complete reproducibility.
deterministic_randomization.rank_rule: For each frozen KYM photo ID i, compute SHA256(seed + ':' + decimal(i)); sort lexicographically ascending by the 64-character lowercase hex digest.

eligibility_screen.stop_rule: Stop when 20 eligible unique D4 items are frozen; if all 832 are screened and fewer than 15 eligible items exist, declare FRAME_INSUFFICIENT and keep CRI locked.
eligible: Exact frame or footage from The Skeleton Dance (1929)
Direct crop, resize, loop, compression, colorization, overlay text, or minor compositing where the underlying 1929 visual nucleus remains source-identifiable
ineligible: Independent redraw or 3D/SFM/Blender/game-engine remake with no retained original visual substrate: belongs to D2
Generic dancing skeleton with no source-identifiable 1929 Disney visual nucleus
Exact duplicate/repost of an already sampled underlying media object when dedupe_key matches
eligibility_screen.ambiguous_rule: If direct-source identity cannot be established from the item and source metadata, mark ELIGIBILITY_OPEN, do not count it toward N, log it, and continue.

anti_leakage_protocol.phase_1: During eligibility screening, record only source identity, media provenance, date/ID and dedupe status. Do not assign D4 context class, LRS, affect, semantics, or CRI contribution.
anti_leakage_protocol.phase_2: Freeze the final eligible sample IDs and exclusions ledger in a successor artifact.
anti_leakage_protocol.phase_3: Only after sample freeze, code context taxonomy, LRS, polarity and LES.
anti_leakage_protocol.phase_4: Compute CRI only if minimum N and coding-completeness conditions are met.

context_taxonomy_after_freeze.coding_rule: Exactly one primary_context per included D4 item for CRI; secondary tags are descriptive only.
context_taxonomy_after_freeze.other_rule: OTHER_PENDING is logged but excluded from CRI until adjudicated under a predeclared rule; no new category may be invented after inspecting the final distribution without an amendment.

cri.allowed_input: Only the frozen KYM conditional-prevalence sample from this preregistration.

kill_switches: If the frozen KYM manifest cannot be reconstructed and hash-verified, stop.
If source identity screening starts using caption/context desirability, invalidate and restart from the same frozen frame with a blind recode.
If fewer than 15 eligible unique items exist after exhaustive screening, FRAME_INSUFFICIENT and CRI remains forbidden.
If a sampled item belongs to D2 rather than direct/near-direct D4 visual reuse, exclude it before context coding and log the reason.
epistemic_firewall: KYM is a curated archive, so conditional unbiasedness within the frozen gallery does not imply internet-wide prevalence.
A high CRI would demonstrate context diversity inside this sampling frame, not causally prove virality or universal replaceability.
High LRS cannot substitute for direct visual-source eligibility or LES.
No outcome-dependent frame switching is allowed after this preregistration unless this frame fails a predeclared kill-switch.
canonical_seal: THE ALTERNATIVE FRAME IS FROZEN BEFORE CONTEXT CODING. ALL 832 KYM SKELETONS-GALLERY IDS ARE ENUMERATED; A DETERMINISTIC HASH-RANKED ORDER SELECTS ITEMS FOR SOURCE-IDENTITY SCREENING. CRI REMAINS LOCKED UNTIL AT LEAST 15 ELIGIBLE DIRECT/NEAR-DIRECT SKELETON-DANCE REENCODINGS ARE FROZEN.
